name: Extra Mettle
body:
You show much more mettle in battle than your peers.

Prerequisite(s): Mettle class feature or a feat that provides a Mettle pool.

Benefit(s): You gain 2 extra Mettle points per day and your maximum Mettle increases by 2.

Special: If you have the mettle class feature, this feat may be taken multiple times and its effects stack.
